recipes.preparation: nearest-fill retained margins for sequential filters; composites may use recorded explicit edge-plane vertical preparation; restore original mask
recipes.method_revision: archie-filters-4: independent Burg composite preparation; explicit Oasis/standard standalone DY Nyquist convention; positive-down vertical; central composite derivatives
recipes.agc_definition: global supported-core RMS divided by reflect square-window local RMS; gain capped; units retained
recipes.local_filters_definition: LP: reflect Gaussian sigma metres, truncate 4 sigma; HP: input minus LP; MEDIAN: odd square median; STD/VAR: odd square population moments; workspace nearest-filled before filtering
limitations: RTP discards FFT DC and caps gain; angles measured from grid north.
AGC is a native RMS normalization, not certified Oasis method 0 equivalence.
Sequential filtering of angles is allowed and changes physical units accordingly.
Workspace filling and padding influence boundaries; no synthetic coverage published.

filter.display_mask: Apply the same support mask after the derivative.
